summary: This page serves as the cover of Elite UK REIT's 2025 Annual Report, introducing the Singapore-listed UK REIT managed by Elite UK REIT Management Pte. Ltd. and its sponsors Ho Lee Group and Elite Partners Holdings. The text provides high-level portfolio details including a total asset value of £424.7 million as at 31 December 2025 across 148 properties, along with SGX trading codes MXNU (GBP) and MENU (SGD).

This page presents the Table of Contents for the SGX REIT annual report, listing sections including Corporate Profile, Key Financial Highlights, Portfolio Overview, and Financial Statements. No schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, total return tables, or distribution highlights are present on this page.

This page presents the Key Financial Highlights for the SGX REIT, featuring DPU / distribution / financial highlights including Revenue of £38.0 m, Net Property Income of £36.0 m, Distributable Income of £19.3 m, and a Distribution Yield of 8.4 % as at 31 Dec 2025. It also details Total Return of 34.2 %, Borrowing Cost of 4.7 %, Interest Coverage Ratio of 2.6 x, Fixed Rate Debt at 85 %, Net Gearing of 40.7 %, and Debt Headroom of £62.6 m.

This page presents the Portfolio Overview for an SGX REIT, featuring key metrics including a portfolio value of £424.7 m as of 31 Dec 2024, 11 tenants, and a 98.6% occupancy rate alongside regional breakdowns of Net Internal Area (NIA), Valuation, and Gross Rental Income (GRI). The reporting unit is explicitly stated as pounds (£) with values in millions (e.g., £424.7 m), while no audited Portfolio Statement, DPU/financial highlights, or tenant mix tables are present.

This page details key corporate milestones for SGX REIT's FY2025, including a 2.0% year-on-year portfolio valuation increase to £424.7 million and a declared Distribution Per Unit (DPU) of 2.87 pence in February 2025, which was 5.0% higher than the previous year. The content also covers strategic asset repositioning initiatives such as offering power supply for a new data centre at Peel Park, Blackpool, and improvements in capital structure that lowered borrowing costs to 4.7%.

This page details Elite UK REIT's corporate milestones, including the acquisition of three government-leased properties (£9.2 million total) and a successful £4.0 million private placement to fund these assets. It reports that the 1H 2025 Distribution Per Unit (DPU) increased 5.5% year-on-year to 1.54 pence, alongside asset repositioning plans for Lindsay House, Dundee and divestments of St Paul's House, Chippenham and Victoria Road, Kirkcaldy.

Ltd.), and the trustee (Perpetual (Asia) Limited). The content outlines governance roles including the Board of Directors, executive officers such as the CEO, CIO, CFO, and HIR, along with key committees like the Audit and Risk Committee, without containing any audited financial statements, revenue data, tenant information, or DPU highlights.

This page presents financial highlights for Elite UK REIT, including a DPU of 3.03 pence (5.6% yoy increase), distributable income of £19.3 million (£424.7m portfolio value at valuation date), net finance costs of £14.0 million, and a net gearing ratio of 40.7%.

This page presents the Profit or Loss and Distributable Income to Unitholders table (£'000) detailing FY2025 revenue of £36,590k, net property income of £34,623k, profit before tax of £15,994k, and a distribution per unit (DPU) of 3.03 pence, alongside Key Financial Indicators showing total gross borrowings of £189.6m, aggregate leverage at 42.8%, and net asset value per unit of £0.40 as at 31 Dec 2025.

The page presents a Debt Maturity Profile table detailing £'m debt levels for 2027 and 2029 alongside an Interest Rate Sensitivity table showing impacts on Distributable Income and DPU, followed by a Private Placement table tracking the use of £4.0 million gross proceeds for asset acquisition in FY2025.

This page presents an **Acquisitions** table detailing the purchase of three government-leased properties (Custom House, Felixstowe; Merlin House, Carmarthen; Priory Court, Dover) by Elite Dram Limited for a total price of £9.2 million with valuations totaling £10.7 million as at 31 December 2025. The reporting unit is explicitly stated as **£'m**, and the content further highlights portfolio reconstitution through these acquisitions, tactical divestments, and asset repositioning initiatives resulting in a 2.0% year-on-year valuation increase to £424.7 million.

The page presents a Divestments table listing four properties sold in 2025 with total proceeds of £5.9 million and includes an Asset repositioning table detailing three conversion projects (Cambria House, Lindsay House, and Peel Park) targeting PBSA and data centre uses.
